description: This file defines utilities for locating and working with a runtime environment, specifically focusing on Node.js runtime version detection and validation. It includes data structures for representing runtime versions, resolution results, and errors, as well as logic to find the Node executable in given search paths, parse its version, and compare it against minimum required versions.

classes.name: RuntimeVersion
classes.description: Represents a semantic version of the runtime, comparable and convertible to string.

classes.name: RuntimeResolution
classes.description: Encapsulates details about the resolved runtime, including type, path, and version.

classes.name: RuntimeResolutionError
classes.description: Enumerates possible errors during runtime resolution, such as not found, unsupported version, or parse failure.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Attempts to locate and verify the Node runtime in specified search paths, returning success with details or failure with error.

methods.name: describeFailure
methods.description: Provides a human-readable message explaining why runtime resolution failed.

methods.name: findExecutable
methods.description: Searches the provided paths for an executable file with the given name.

methods.name: readVersion
methods.description: Runs the runtime binary with '--version' to retrieve its version string.
